entry_self_contained: entries/baseline.html inlines its JS and CSS (vite inlineDynamicImports + single-file transform), so it opens and runs directly from file:// with no server and no external request.
fixture_scope: Fixtures replace BACKEND DATA only (playground mock + baseline fixtures); every rendered element comes from the renderer sources consumed by this build. They do not represent real backend behavior.

inputs.note: repo_files hold the WORKING TREE contents actually consumed by the build (hashes prove currency — a changed file cannot match). packages/lockfiles record the dependency set vite resolved. references/design-system.json is intentionally NOT an input: it binds upstream sources; material outputs are downstream. Only the revision string is fingerprinted, avoiding model/output cycles.
